FAQPreview.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPreview.description: Got questions? We've got answers. If you have some other questions, feel free to contact us.

0.q: How long does the recharge take?
0.a: After you submit your payment proof, our team manually verifies it. Most orders are processed within 15-30 minutes during working hours.

1.q: Where can I find my MLBB User ID?
1.a: Open Mobile Legends, tap your profile picture in the top left corner. Your User ID is the number shown below your settings (e.g., 123456789).

2.q: Where can I find my Zone ID?
2.a: The Zone ID is the 4-digit number in parentheses right next to your User ID on your MLBB profile page (e.g., (1234)).

3.q: What happens if my payment is rejected?
3.a: If we cannot verify your payment, your order will be marked as rejected. Our support team will contact you to resolve the issue or process a refund.

4.a: You select your package, enter your game details, and pay using your preferred method. Once you upload the payment proof and we verify it, we send the Diamonds directly to your account.
